## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction: Studio shows an author message, a located field path, and a collapsible detail

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T16:16Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in Studio's refusal banners (the autosave and publish error surfaces) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the Studio browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`).

- **Why p2:** authors see class names, tracker ids and raw Zod paths verbatim (measured).
- **Direction:**
  - split each refusal into an author message, a field path mapped to the inspector field, and a collapsible detail
  - the raw server text stays reachable in the detail
- The server half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#22093: spec strings that reach forms carry internal references. Each card fixes its own side.
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

- Studio's refusal surfaces:
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the autosave and publish error strips that render `formatMetadataError(e)`, about `:481`–`:487`, `:697`–`:702`, `:785`, and the pillars' save-error strips);
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` (its `PublishFailure` grammar);

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate; default tier). `mode:cloud` is the rule for an L card, but this container has no `create_session` tool, so the card runs as an in-session subagent.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell + data-objectstack: Studio's autosave and publish banners print formatMetadataError(e) verbatim, which carries assertObjectMetadataWritable's developer prose (MetadataClient.save, objectstack#20827, objectui#7714, wire paths) and raw Zod issue paths (nodes.2.config.title, navigation.1.objectName) | the platform path: the refusal reaches the client as a structured error (issues with paths), so an author sentence plus a located field plus a collapsible detail can be built client-side | every low-code author whose Studio save or publish is refused (measured: switching a field to Picklist prints the guard's developer text)`
Thread-read: 6041997331
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking. No `area:studio` card of this seat is in flight. Seat 1's objectui#11783 (`area:studio`, in flight) holds the files named above, which are disjoint.

Fold-or-serial with objectui#11786 (`pm:queue`, the autosave refusing normal intermediate states; same autosave path and the same guard): **serial**, not folded. Fold gate ① fails: wording versus timing are different defect shapes. objectui#11786 waits for this card.

No open objectui PR touches the files above (read 2026-10-07T23:39Z; open: #11837, #11836, #11600, #11069).

Why `Clause-②: no`: author-facing text and a Studio-side split of refusals inside `@object-ui/app-shell`, plus message-text edits in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s guard. Its error type and exports are unchanged. A new export, prop or type member (for example a structured refusal type exported from `data-objectstack`), or a language-pack key, is a stop: the dev reports it before opening the PR, and the seat amends this line.

A published text that this change makes false is this change's to fix, in the same PR. The dev's open question is answered **A**: change the two quoted prefixes to the guard's new wording, with no other README text.
- **Line pointers corrected (the seat's):** the claim's `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` pointers `:481`–`:487`, `:697`–`:702` and `:785` are package-list read failures (`fetchPackages` toasts), not save strips. The dev converted the save strips of the Data, Automations and Interfaces pillars and left those toasts alone, which is right.
- **`Clause-②: no`** stands: the guard's signature, error type and exports are unchanged. Its parameter is renamed `writer` → `_writer`, a name only.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-08T01:33Z. PR objectui#11848, head `00304bc`.

- **PR shape:** draft against `main`, with `455c646` merged in (no rebase). `main` has since moved one commit (`59ce048`, seat 1's objectui#11790), and `git merge-tree` of `origin/main` and this head is clean; the queue tests that merge. First line `Fixes #11785`, no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` at line start. Commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. Assigned to `os-support-ai`.
- **Scope:** 11 files, +1142/−79, on the claim's surface as amended (`6050143821`):
  - `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the Data, Automations and Interfaces pillars' save strips (the `fetchPackages` toasts are left alone, as the amendment corrected);
  - `studio-design/metadataError.ts`: the refusal view model (`StudioRefusal`, the three per-pillar locators, `plainRefusal` as the unchanged fallback);
  - new designer rows (en, zh) in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`;
  - `data-objectstack`'s `object-metadata-write-guard.ts` (message text only) and the two `// throws:` quotes in its published `README.md`;
  - the tests beside them and the changeset (`patch` on both packages).

  The published `formatMetadataError` is untouched, so its other call sites print what they printed. Nothing is added to either package entry. No governed path.
- **Diff read (the seat's own):**
  - The guard's two messages drop the door label, `@objectstack/spec` and the tracker ids, and now begin "The object was not saved: the field …". The field, its type and the remedy are kept. The signature is unchanged; `writer` is renamed `_writer`, a name only.
  - Studio tells the guard's refusal apart without parsing prose and without a new export: it re-runs the guard on the body it sent, and counts `e` as that refusal only when `e` has no status, no issues, and a byte-identical message. Anything else falls back to `plainRefusal`, which is the old verbatim text.
  - A server 422's issues are placed by the pillar's locator (a field label, a step label plus its inspector input, a navigation item plus its input). A path the page cannot place keeps its line under Details, with the generic sentence.
  - Each strip renders one sentence, a "Show me" button when the path maps, and a closed "Details" holding exactly `formatMetadataError(e)`.
- **README patch round (`36165fc..00304bc`):** exactly two lines, `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` at `:784` and `:811`, each `// throws:` prefix now the guard's measured first line. Read by the seat on the compare. After this PR, the old prefix "refused this object metadata write" has no occurrence in the tree outside changelogs (on `main`: 2 in the guard, 2 in the README).
- **Ruling honoured:** triage's direction on the card: an author sentence, a located field, the technical detail collapsible. The amendment's answer A (README quotes fixed in this PR) is done.
- **Changeset sentences checked against the head:**
  - "Each strip now shows one sentence that names the input … A "Show me" button opens that field, step or navigation item. The raw text stays under a closed "Details" disclosure, unchanged";
  - "Switching a field to Picklist before it has an option now says "Changes not saved: the field “Status” needs at least one option…"";
  - "`assertObjectMetadataWritable` no longer prints the door's class name, a package name or tracker ids … Its signature, error type and exports are unchanged";
  - "`formatMetadataError` is unchanged … Nothing is added to either package entry".
- **Reverse verification (dev report):**
  - Ablation through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the Data page's catch put back to `plainRefusal(e)` gives both Data pins red (2/2), the first receiving the guard's old-style text. Restored with the blob equal to HEAD.
  - The derived test union on `36165fc`: 228 files, 2608 tests passed. It includes the 11 plugin-designer `MetadataFieldsPage*` suites, which are the non-Studio `formatMetadataError` callers and the control.
  - The patch round on `00304bc`: `check:doc-snippets` (every package README) and `check:readme-exports` exit 0 after the build; the type-check exit 0.
- **Gates:** CI on `00304bc` (`head_sha` equals the PR head): 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, its shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failure. `Lint` and `Type Check` are success. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Contract review:** not required (`Clause-②: no`).

Findings:
- `translateValidationMessage` maps a bare `Required` to "A name is required." whatever the path, and the new sentence inherits it as `ResourceEditPage` does. Not reached at a public door in this run, so it does not pass the filing gate → `Acceptance notes`
- Publish failures stay toasts (`formatPublishFailures`), and create dialogs print `error.message`. Both are surfaces the card did not measure → `Acceptance notes`

Follow-up: objectui#11786 (the autosave refusing intermediate states) is serial behind this card and is picked once this lands.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now.
